contract.input: raw query, canonical unit text as an ordered tokenizer pair
contract.score: single classification logit converted to float32; larger means more relevant
contract.tie_break: original dense rank, then native source order
contract.candidate_scope: all 1214 frozen support pairs from 77 questions; no candidate additions
contract.deduplication: exact native text, retain the first ranked fitting source location

length_audit.tokenizer: pinned reranker fast tokenizer, complete query-passage pairs

analysis_specification.scope: all 77 prepared development questions in 24 families and all 1214 support pairs
analysis_specification.deduplication: exact native text, first ranked fitting unit
analysis_specification.dense_ranking: original frozen prepared ranked_ids; same candidate_ids as the reranker
analysis_specification.reranker_scores: fixed revision raw classification logits; all saved outputs independently audited
analysis_specification.question_weighted: sampled question delta sum divided by sampled question count
analysis_specification.family_balanced: mean of sampled within-family question-mean deltas
analysis_specification.interval: two-sided percentile 95%, linear quantiles at 0.025 and 0.975
analysis_specification.analysis_timing: specification frozen before this reranker inference; other exposed development results already existed

limits: Exposed validation development data; no independent confirmation or official test QA.
Given-document fixed-pool evidence selection; no corpus retrieval or answer generation.
Cross-encoder scores are raw ranking logits, not calibrated support probabilities.
All k=1/2/3 are retained; no metric-driven threshold or best-k substitution.
Equal evidence caps do not imply equal actual evidence lengths.
Local inference has no paid API charge; download and device costs are not monetary measurements.
Reported model-input tokens include the query and pair special tokens; evidence tokens use the separate frozen BGE tokenizer.
All 77 questions are exposed development data, not independent confirmation.
Fixed-pool, given-document selection does not evaluate corpus retrieval, answers or a shared-relation architecture.
The primary k=3 and both k=1/2 sensitivities retain every metric and every sign of the result.
Percentile intervals are descriptive, unadjusted across comparisons, and do not establish significance or future performance.
Whole-family resampling preserves all questions within each sampled family; larger families still affect question-weighted means more.
Equal evidence caps do not imply equal actual evidence lengths; paired token differences are reported separately.
Reranker logits are not calibrated probabilities; no learned threshold or winner selection is performed.
Comparisons reuse one deterministic reranker run; bootstrap intervals do not include device/precision or model-run variability.

config.ranking: CPU FP32 exhaustive inner product; ties use frozen index order
config.owner_ties: production RRF tie policy, ending with stable chunk_id
config.projection: fused owner order, then descending leaf score and frozen global row; unique (doc_id,unit_id)
config.leaf_direct: dense top8 plus immediate same-document neighbors capped16; dense order
config.rendering: unchanged [unit_id] and native text; final global source order; no source prefix in either scope
config.chunk_model_input: exact adapter ChunkRecord.text only, no path/anchor/instruction
config.bootstrap: family-cluster multinomial resampling, shared PCG64 draws; linear percentile 95%
config.paired_orientation: later minus earlier in fixed method list; all three pairs within each scope

limits: Previously exposed validation development data; exploratory cluster intervals are not independent confirmation or multiplicity-controlled inference.
Rule chunks are not JEV relations or Boundary Refiner output; no complete online SLAC or answer-quality claim.
Dual retrieval adds a top8 chunk channel and its compute; this is part of the comparison.
Production RRF gives each leaf hit a vote, so multiple leaves in a large owner accumulate votes.
Leaf-direct is a background baseline; source-qualified deduplication differs from the earlier text-only corpus bridge.
The exact CPU ranking reference is used; no FAISS latency or production ANN claim.
Source-qualified exact-string evidence metrics require the correct paper; official-string scores are also retained.
Original rendered unit IDs may repeat across documents; these packs are not an answer-generation format.
BGE evidence tokens include headers/separators/specials but exclude generator query/instructions.
Cached query/leaf reuse and one shared chunk encoding are separately timed, not cold-start end-to-end latency.
No support labels are reused for newly retrieved candidates and no API calls are made.

publication_scope: Parameters, aggregate counts and source hashes only; no actual IDs, raw text or credentials.
